title: The Opening Freeway
address: Harbor (110) / Century (105) Freeway interchange, Los Angeles, CA
shotFacing: Northeast, along the elevated ramp deck
accessibility: No pedestrian access to the ramp itself; it is an active freeway. View only from public streets nearby, and do not stop on the freeway.

title: Mia's Courtyard Apartments
shotFacing: East, down the centerline of E. 3rd St
accessibility: Public street; the courtyard itself is private residential property, so stay outside the gate.

title: The Long Walk Home
short: Mia's route past two Hollywood murals
address: Vine St & Argyle Ave, then 1661 Wilcox Ave, Hollywood, CA
shotFacing: Multiple: east on Vine, south on Argyle, then Wilcox Ave
accessibility: Public sidewalks throughout; the murals are on private building walls, viewable from the street.

title: Lipton's (The Smoke House)

shotFacing: West, entering from the lounge doorway

title: Walking Between the Sound Stages
short: The studio tour, and the 'I hate jazz' scene
address: Avenue D, Warner Bros. Studios, Burbank, CA 91522
accessibility: Access only via a paid, scheduled Warner Bros. Studio Tour; no public walk-up access to the backlot.

title: The Lighthouse Jazz Club
accessibility: Public venue, cover charge likely on live music nights.

title: The Pier
address: Hermosa Ave & Pier Ave, Hermosa Beach, CA 90254

title: Angels Flight
address: 351 S Hill St, Los Angeles, CA 90013
shotFacing: Facing the ascending car, from the lower station
accessibility: Public funicular, small fare; operating hours may vary.

title: The Rialto Theatre
address: 1023 Fair Oaks Ave, South Pasadena, CA 91030
accessibility: Exterior viewing from the public sidewalk; the building itself has been closed since 2010 and its future use is undecided.

title: The Observatory
address: 2800 E Observatory Rd, Los Angeles, CA 90027
shotFacing: South, approaching on the pedestrian path
accessibility: Free public grounds; planetarium shows are ticketed and can sell out on busy days.

title: The Hilltop View
address: Mount Hollywood Dr (near Cathy's Corner), Griffith Park, Los Angeles, CA
shotFacing: North, into the San Fernando Valley
bestTime: Daytime only — do not attempt at dusk
accessibility: Foot and bicycle access only; the road is closed to vehicles. Isolated area — go in a group, bring water, and turn back well before dark.

title: The Restaurant Escape
short: Mia bolts from a bad date
shotFacing: West then north, Beverly Blvd to Harper Ave
accessibility: Public restaurant; the street scenes are on public sidewalks and roadway.

title: The Bridge at Sunset
accessibility: Public walkway alongside active vehicle traffic; the surrounding streets are a confusing tangle of freeway on/off-ramps, so plan the walking approach rather than trying to park directly on the bridge.

title: The Food Hall
accessibility: Public market, open daily; can be crowded at lunchtime.

title: The Palm Trees
address: Elysian Park Rd (Angels Point), Los Angeles, CA 90012
shotFacing: East, from Park Drive toward Elysian Park Rd
accessibility: Public park roads; avoid Dodger Stadium game days when nearby traffic is heavy.
